\begin{example} \end{example}[Shrinking round $2$-sphere is a $\kappa $-solution] ↗ def:ancient-solution

If $g_0$ is the round metric on $S^2$ with scalar curvature $1$, then $g(t)=(1-t)g_0$ is an ancient Ricci flow. It is a $\kappa $-solution whenever $\kappa $ does not exceed the volume of a unit ball in the unit $2$-sphere. \end{example}
